body: slice-5 TASK-5-1: delete the event-prompt self-fetch fallback prose in `_build_delta_entries`. The no-SHA fallback instructed reviewers to "fetch and read the actual file diffs yourself" — incompatible with the per-role-worktree topology where commits live in the host object store and the wrapper syncs them in before prompt render when a proposal SHA is known. No string literal in event_prompt.py emits `git fetch` / `git merge` / `git pull` or any brc-history disk path. The existing `degraded baseline` / `adversarial-re-review` marker test stays green.

body: ACK task-5-4 (orchestrator/tests/test_prompt_sync_ratchet.py @ 9fbeb6cba). All TASK-5-4 acceptance criteria met and empirically verified: (1) test fails on reintroduced `git fetch`/`git merge`/`git pull`/brc-history imperatives — covered by parametrized mutation test over 7 samples including tab-evasion and uppercase variants; (2) test passes on the post-cleanup tree — I ran pytest against the materialized proposed tree, 24/24 pass; (3) `git show` and `git log` references pass through via the inverse-ratchet parametrized test, and every allowlist entry carries a justification (the single entry has a 12-line `# JUSTIFICATION:` block naming the slice-5 TASK-5-1 commit b914f027d, the surrounding function, and why the literal can't be reworded out).
